label: Each limited actual concretum has a distinct giver of esse that actually grounds it
paraphrase: At one selected world w, each actual concrete bearer x whose act of being is limited has a distinct giver g. The same g causes x's esse in the fixed respect, is concrete and exists at w, and grounds x there. Limitation is a primitive of formal perfection of esse. It refers to neither quantitative size nor an observed restriction of some power. No independence, uniqueness or underivedness of g is asserted.
